d: Imagine coming home to a cooked meal, folded laundry and spotless floors. Except there's no housekeeper. There's a robot. China's XPeng has unveiled a humanoid robot so lifelike that people suspected a human was hiding inside its body. But this is more than a viral stunt. The company wants to mass-produce its robot and believes household robots could become reality within the next few years. But can these machines actually handle the unpredictability of everyday life? Palki Sharma explores the race to bring robots into our homes.
